2607.00848.title: MetaHOPE: A Metaphor-Oriented Evaluation Framework for Analysing MT and LLM Translation Errors
2607.00848.paper_summary: In this opinion paper, we propose MetaHOPE, an error severity-aware annotation framework for evaluating metaphor translations. Metaphors present challenges for machine translation (MT) and natural language understanding and processing (NLU, NLP), because it presents the features of semantic complexity, contextual dependency, and cultural embeddings that can lead to ambiguity issues for NLP models. To investigate how state-of-the-art NLP models perform on translating metaphors, we select three representative systems, i.e., GoogleMT, GPT5.4, and Hunyuan-7b as Neural MT (NMT) models and LLMs. We used two human-annotated metaphor corpora, including VUAMC and PSUCMC for English-to-Chinese and Chinese-to-English translation purposes. The original corpora we used are monolingual, where we carried out error annotation using the MetaHOPE framework, and also produced the human post-edited gold reference for bilingual use as a new resource. We believe the MetaHOPE evaluation framework for metaphor translation annotation, the parallel corpora resources, and the error analysis on SOTA automatic translation models can be useful and shed some light for the field of metaphor translation study. We share our resources publicly upon paper acceptance.
2607.00848.paper_summary_zh: 在這篇意見文章中，我們提出了MetaHOPE，一個考慮錯誤嚴重性的註釋框架，用於評估隱喻翻譯。隱喻對於機器翻譯（MT）和自然語言理解與處理（NLU, NLP）提出了挑戰，因為它展現了語義複雜性、上下文依賴性和文化嵌入等特徵，這可能導致NLP模型出現歧義問題。為了調查最先進的NLP模型在翻譯隱喻時的表現，我們選擇了三個具代表性的系統，即GoogleMT、GPT5.4和Hunyuan-7b，作為神經機器翻譯（NMT）模型和大型語言模型（LLMs）。我們使用了兩個人類註釋的隱喻語料庫，包括VUAMC和PSUCMC，用於英語到中文和中文到英語的翻譯目的。我們使用的原始語料庫是單語的，我們使用MetaHOPE框架進行了錯誤註釋，並為雙語使用製作了人類後編輯的黃金參考作為新資源。我們相信，MetaHOPE隱喻翻譯註釋的評估框架、平行語料資源以及對最先進自動翻譯模型的錯誤分析，對隱喻翻譯研究領域將是有用的並提供一些啟示。我們會在論文被接受後公開分享我們的資源。
2607.00848.author: Jiahui Liang et.al.
